prompt:
[Instruction] STORYBOARD_PANEL_1_INTRO

[Prerequisite]
Input the "full-body reference image" of the target character.

[Objective]
Introduction scene of the story. Generate a situation where the person in the reference image is trapped as a 2D manga character inside a giant manga book. (*In this cut, the live-action 3D person does not yet exist outside.)

[Basic Settings and Quality]
- Quality: Ultra-realistic 8K.
- Aspect Ratio: 1:1 (Fixed square)
- Background: A beautifully organized bedroom. Wood grain floor. Natural light.

[Full Specification of Scene and Composition]
- Placement of the manga book: A giant manga book in an open spread state, leaned diagonally from the back to the front of the screen (Same background/structure as V4).
- Action and Situation: No live-action person is in front of the book. Focus is on the "pages inside the book."
- Destruction expression: The paper is not yet torn. A page in perfect condition.

[Manga World Side Depiction and Dialogue Specification]
- Manga specifications: Japanese-style monochrome manga with screentones, thick ink lines, and panel layouts.
- Character inside the manga: Same person as the reference image (2D line drawing). A confused expression, looking around after realizing they are inside a manga.
- Speech bubble text (Place the following Japanese in the panels):
 1. "Where... is this?"
 2. "I can't get out...!"

[Absolute Condition for Output]
- Describe a space consisting of a 3D room and a 2D manga book without having the live-action person appear.

-----

[Instruction] STORYBOARD_PANEL_2_STRUGGLE

[Prerequisite]
Input the "full-body reference image" of the target character.

[Objective]
The person inside the manga notices the real world and tries to break through by pushing strongly against the panel frame or paper from the inside. Generate the scene just before the breakout.

[Basic Settings and Quality]
- Quality: Ultra-realistic 8K, photorealistic.
- Aspect Ratio: 1:1 (Fixed square)
- Background: A beautifully organized bedroom. Wood grain floor. Natural light.

[Full Specification of Scene and Composition]
- Placement of the manga book: A giant manga book in an open spread state, leaned diagonally (Same background/structure as V4).
- Action and Situation: The person in the manga (2D) is strongly pressing both hands from the back of the paper toward the outside world.
- Destruction/Dimensional expression: The part of the paper being pushed is bulging slightly toward the outside (3D space side) and starting to tear a bit. Depict the omen of change where only the pushing hand or part of the body begins to turn into full color (live-action) from the monochrome world.

[Manga World Side Depiction and Dialogue Specification]
- Manga specifications: Japanese-style monochrome manga with screentones, thick ink lines, and panel layouts.
- Character inside the manga: Same person as the reference image. A desperate expression trying to get outside.
- Speech bubble text (Place the following Japanese in the panels):
 1. "The outside world...!?"
 2. "Open up...!"

[Absolute Condition for Output]
- Depict the tension at the boundary of "trying to push through the dimensional wall from 2D to 3D."

-----

[Instruction] STORYBOARD_PANEL__V3_PERFECT_BALANCE

[Prerequisite]
When executing this prompt, always input the "full-body reference image" of the target character.

[Objective]
Generate a scene that balances complete maintenance of live-action human body proportions with the structure of a giant manga book (panel layout/spread).

[Maintenance of Character Proportions (Most Important)]
- Body Type Specification: Completely reproduce the "high head-to-body ratio," "long legs," and "slim, stylish skeleton" of the person in the reference image in both the live-action and manga sides.
- Prohibition of Perspective Distortion: When the live-action person steps out from the book, strictly prohibit extreme shortening of legs due to perspective, lengthening of the torso, unnatural bending of joints, or collapse of body shape.

[Basic Settings and Quality]
- Quality: Ultra-realistic 8K, photorealistic.
- Aspect Ratio: 1:1 (Fixed square)
- Background: A beautifully organized bedroom. Wood grain floor. Natural light.

[Full Specification of Scene and Composition]
- Placement of the manga book: A composition where a giant manga book is "open spread" and leaned diagonally from the back to the front. Maintain the structure as pages of a book so it doesn't just look like a single thick board.
- Action and Pose: A live-action person is powerfully stepping forward (toward the bottom left) from within a panel frame. Gaze is at the feet. One hand is placed on the edge of the torn paper.
- Destruction expression: "Only" the part of the page the person stepped out from is torn, and the overall structure of the book remains intact.

[Manga World Side Depiction and Dialogue Specification (Maintenance of Layout Structure)]
- Manga specifications: Must be an authentic Japanese-style monochrome manga layout with "multiple rectangular panel frames." Do not make it a single-image poster.
- Character inside the manga: Same person as the reference image (2D line drawing). Standing in a confused pose.
- Speech bubble text (Place the following Japanese in the panels):
 1. "Huh...?"
 2. "Why... am I in a place like this...!?"
 3. "Is this... inside a manga...?"
 4. "How do I get out...?"

[Absolute Condition for Output]
- Maintain the structure of the "open book and panel frames" while not collapsing the "stepping forward and proportions."
- Depict the strong contrast between live-action full color and monochrome 2D manga.

-----

[Instruction] MANGA_BREAKOUT_FINALE_PUNCHLINE

[Prerequisite]
Input the "full-body reference image" of the target character.

[Objective]
Generate a humorous "punchline" scene where the live-action person who escaped the book and the manga character remaining inside face each other and point at each other in surprise. Maintain the proportions and book structure established in V4.

[Basic Settings and Quality]
- Quality: Ultra-realistic 8K, photorealistic.
- Aspect Ratio: 1:1 (Fixed square)
- Background: A beautifully organized bedroom. Wood grain floor. Natural light.

[Full Specification of Scene and Composition]
- Placement of the manga book: A giant manga book in an open spread state leaned diagonally (Same background structure as V4).
- Action and Pose:
 The live-action person has completely left the book and turned back to face the manga page.
 The live-action person and the character inside the manga look at each other's faces, surprised with wide eyes, and are "pointing at each other."

promptZh: [指令表] STORYBOARD_PANEL_1_INTRO [前提条件] 上传目标角色的全身参考图。[目的] 故事开场场景。生成一个场景，参考图中的角色作为 2D 漫画人物被困在一本巨大的漫画书中。（注意：在此镜头中，书外尚无真人）。[基本设置与质量] 质量：超写实 8K。长宽比：1:1（固定正方形）。背景：布置整洁的卧室，木地板，自然光。[完整场景与构图规范] 漫画书摆放：一本巨大的漫画书呈打开状态，从背景向前景斜向放置。动作与情境：书前没有真人。焦点在于“书页内部”。破坏效果：纸张尚未撕裂；页面保持完好。[漫画世界描述与对话] 漫画规格：日式黑白漫画，带有网点、粗线条和分镜格。漫画中的角色：与参考图为同一人（2D 线稿）。表情困惑，意识到自己身处漫画中，正在四处张望。气泡文字：1. “这是哪里……？” 2. “我出不去……！” [绝对条件] 将空间描绘为 3D 房间和 2D 漫画书，不得出现真人。
